narr: Deep monsoon moisture brought thunderstorms with heavy rain across portions of northern Arizona.
ev: Granite Creek rose 4.5 feet at the USGS gauge in Prescott.
Tonto Creek showed a 2.4 foot rise between 515 PM and 645 PM near Jakes Corner before the creek entered Roosevelt Lake.
lsr: A 2.4-FT. RISE WAS OBSERVED BY THE USGS GAGE (TNRA3) ON THE TONTO CREEK FOR 5:15PM-6:45PM.
A 4.5-FT. RISE WAS OBSERVED BY THE USGS GAGE (GRCA3) ON GRANITE CREEK IN PRESCOTT.
